name: hbm_su_qcore_r18b_1021
slot_change_request: r16a retains r15a candidate302.4x280.8um outline, two SRAM placements and21.6um X pin escape halo exactly. No new die adoption; prior approved geometry only. Actualmacroorigin off43.2/pins~10um disposition retained explicitly, not onlattice claim.

pin_regs.reason: The RF read commands, relay writers and COLL writer are captured raw at the pins (the hub bank rung moved to the pin); reducer command, slice/SFU operands and drain decode land in clk_ctl registers; every output is a flop. A wrapper stage would add an edge to the fixed n+1 commit / n+3 read / E+11 scalar calendar.

structural_change: R16a final route NEEDS_RTL TT-4.32 FF+11.68 DRC0; zero LVT swaps. Named RF write-enable path wv_c -> sector/bank hit -> priority-selected2bit row -> equality -> anywriter -> feedback. R17 opt-in ROW_EN=2 local per-row last-writer equations eliminate selected-row bus/equality and redundant any-writer, retaining exact priority/COLL override and k+1 commit. No state/pipeline/port/reset/outline/SRAM/constraints change. MAIN sum-of-selected-row hits; FB local priority row-match mux. Gate must prove native32 and TT/FF timing.

Changedsector7 native10939roots/max32. Parent native/reset and final TT/FF route pending. Geometry retained candidate only, no oldgate/view alias.

fill_reason.pin_bound: routing- and face-bound, measured: at 216x216 (PD 0.52) route r5-ff9f9da83 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION (GRT 20,000 markers flat; no H layer over the two SRAMs, all E<->W traffic in 3 channels). At 280.8x280.8 the forced trial GRT (gate_g4b, 10-18 18:00, ot-pve1) has overflow 0, worst M2 58%; W/E faces carry 731/576 pins over 264.6/264.7 of 280.8 um (94% occupied, <=2.6 pins/um). Shrinking to reach 35% fill (~264 um) re-enters the measured congestion regime; owner 10-17: no white-space compaction for its own sake.
